why: B delivers a cohesive Nordic look in light ash, birch and white that matches the pale floor and white walls, and its 90 cm bookcase properly anchors the right wall; its only weak point is a hard wooden chair that is less comfortable than requested. A mixes an industrial pipe desk, a traditional honey-wood chair and an English-style armchair into an incoherent set, and its 40 cm bookcase is too narrow for the wall.
